name: Targets from pathways
descriptions: A Python pipeline that, given a target and a disease, ranks candidate alternative targets using a pathway-based gene-gene graph.
Originally developed at the Open Targets Hackathon (October 21-22, 2025).
Time of post-hackathon human and agentic work ~3 days.

name: GNN gene prioritization
descriptions: Compares GNN-based and a network-propagation methods for prioritizing candidate disease genes.
Originally developed at the BioAI Hackathon at the University of Warsaw (May 12-15, 2025).
Time of post-hackathon human and agentic work ~1 hour.

name: Virus susceptibility
descriptions: A Python pipeline to build a vector database from the CORD-19 dataset and query it for relevant scientific articles using semantic similarity.
Originally developed at the CMU / DNAnexus Hackathon (October 19-21, 2023).
Time of post-hackathon human and agentic work ~2 hours.
